scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @iwantit/web" "npm run dev -w @iwantit/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @iwantit/shared && npm run build -w @iwantit/web && npm run build -w @iwantit/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @iwantit/web && npm run test -w @iwantit/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iwantit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @iwantit/web && npm run typecheck -w @iwantit/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
